info.title: FleetWire Universal API
info.description: FleetWire gives rental operators API access to bookings, listings, pricing, extras, and tenant activity feeds using bearer API tokens.

post.description: Creates a new booking in FleetWire.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

listingId.description: FleetWire listing ID for the booking.

isPrimaryCustomer.description: Whether this customer is the primary renter.

customerPhoneNumber.description: Primary customer phone number in the phone_number field.

agreeToTerms.description: Whether the customer agrees to the terms.

customerDob.description: Primary customer date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format.

customerAge.description: Primary customer age if required by the tenant checkout validation.

customer.description: Created or matched FleetWire customer record.

l_id.description: Listing ID used for the checkout.

p_id.description: FleetWire payment or planning identifier returned by checkout.

stripePaymentIntent.description: Stripe payment intent payload when present.

success.description: Whether FleetWire created the checkout successfully.
